sourceLabel: SPIRIT 2025 随机试验方案报告
description: 适用于随机试验方案；提示注册、伦理、数据管理和官方清单。
descriptionEn: For randomized-trial protocols; flags registration, ethics, data management, and the official checklist.

rules.message: 请确认方案包含试验注册平台、注册号、URL 和注册日期。
rules.messageEn: Confirm that the protocol includes trial registry, registration number, URL, and registration date.

rules.message: 请确认方案包含伦理批准、知情同意和重要修改沟通安排。
rules.messageEn: Confirm that the protocol covers ethics approval, informed consent, and communication of important amendments.

rules.message: 请逐项完成 SPIRIT 2025 官方清单；本检查不替代 34 项清单。
rules.messageEn: Complete the official SPIRIT 2025 checklist; this check does not replace its 34 items.
